A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the DA system contributes to the development and maintenance of drug addiction by: 1) increasing the reinforcing properties of drugs of abuse; 2) decreasing the reinforcing properties of natural rewards; 3) increasing the motivational salience and reinforcing properties of drug cues; and 4) increasing the likelihood of relapse by decreasing the ability to inhibit drug seeking behaviors.
